北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京今天阴冷，体感-4℃，记得多穿衣保暖。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy and chilly, feels like -4℃. Remember to dress warmly.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天微凉，体感5℃，注意添衣别着凉。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and cool, feels like 5℃. Add clothes to avoid catching a cold.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海今天阴冷，体感4℃，出门别忘添衣。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and cold, feels like 4℃. Don't forget to add layers when going out.
上海.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴朗舒适，气温16℃，享受好天气哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and pleasant, 16℃. Enjoy the good weather!
广州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天宜人，体感17℃，注意适时增减衣物。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and pleasant, feels like 17℃. Adjust clothing as needed.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴冷风大，体感4℃，外出注意防风保暖。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy, cold and windy, feels like 4℃. Pay attention to wind protection and warmth.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天风大，体感4℃，多穿点才暖和。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and windy, feels like 4℃. Wear more to stay warm.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天微凉，体感6℃，出门记得添件外套。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and a bit cool, feels like 6℃. Remember to wear a jacket.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉小雨湿冷，体感-2℃，带伞加厚衣。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is rainy and damp, feels like -2℃. Bring an umbrella and warm clothes.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴冷湿重，体感-3℃，务必注意防寒。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, cold and humid, feels like -3℃. Be sure to stay warm.
西安.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆小雨湿润，体感7℃，出门带把伞哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is rainy and humid, feels like 7℃. Don't forget an umbrella!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨极寒，体感-24℃！全副武装才能出门。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold, feels like -24℃! Full winter gear is a must.
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -24℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳天晴但极寒，体感-23℃，注意防冻保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny but extremely cold, feels like -23℃. Mind the frost and stay warm.
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -23℃ | 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗舒适，体感13℃，尽情享受阳光吧。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and pleasant, feels like 13℃. Enjoy the sunshine!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天风大，体感10℃，多加一件衣服哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and windy, feels like 10℃. Remember to add an extra layer.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴冷，体感-3℃，海边风大注意保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and cold, feels like -3℃. Mind the wind by the sea and stay warm.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云严寒，体感-14℃，注意防风保暖哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and severely cold, feels like -14℃. Pay attention to wind protection and warmth.
